findings.current: Young Hero Cheong? You haven’t seen him either?
findings.korean: 청 소협은? 청 소협도 못 봤어?
findings.reason: Taekyung casually asks a companion he already knows whether he has seen Jeok Cheongang; this is not a formal introduction or deferential address.
findings.replacement: Cheongpung? You haven’t seen him either?
findings.speaker: Jin Taekyung

summary: The address to Cheongpung should use his name because Taekyung speaks to him as a familiar companion.
